item.title: Hudson Valley warblers begin overnight migration pulse
item.description: Field observers along the Hudson River corridor reported a sharp overnight increase in warbler calls before dawn. Researchers note that cold fronts often concentrate migrants, though counts remain provisional until systematic surveys finish. Habitat quality in riverside thickets may influence how long birds stop to forage.

item.title: Catskill trail crews clear storm debris on Plateau Mountain approaches
item.description: Recent thunderstorms left blowdowns across several Catskill hiking approaches. Crews prioritized drainage and footing hazards. Hikers should expect slower travel and treat reports as operational updates rather than formal closures unless posted.
